findings.evidence: grep for `xBj_pos|xBj_le_one|yInel_le_one` over `EpsilonEridani/` returns only Bounds.lean:40,46,57 and their two uses at Bounds.lean:64,68 — no external callers. Bounds.lean:43-44 uses `h.p_dot_q_pos`, `h.q2_pos`; Bounds.lean:49-50 uses `h.p_dot_q_pos`, `h.q2_le_two_p_dot_q`; Bounds.lean:59-60 uses `h.p_dot_k_pos`, `h.p_dot_q_le_p_dot_k`. Domain.lean:186-189 and 201-202 reconstruct exactly these from the weaker hypotheses.
findings.fix: Restate the three Bounds lemmas at the hypotheses they actually use — `xBj_pos (hQ : 0 < K.Q2 g) (hpq : 0 < g K.p K.q)`, `xBj_le_one (hpq : 0 < g K.p K.q) (h : K.Q2 g ≤ 2 * g K.p K.q)`, `yInel_le_one (hpk : 0 < g K.p K.k) (h : g K.p K.q ≤ g K.p K.k)` — and call them from `invariants_mem_kinematicDomain_iff'`/`invariants_mem_kinematicDomain_iff` instead of the inline `div_pos`/`div_le_one` steps. The two in-file callers (`xBj_in_unitInterval`, `yInel_in_unitInterval`, Bounds.lean:62,66) are the only uses in the repository, so the signature change is local.
findings.issue: `invariants_mem_kinematicDomain_iff'` reproves inline, under the minimal hypotheses, the content of three existing lemmas that are stated with the strictly stronger `BasicAssumptions` bundle: line 188 `div_pos hQ h2pq` duplicates `DisKinematics.xBj_pos` (Bounds.lean:40, which uses only `q2_pos` and `p_dot_q_pos` of the five fields), line 188 `(div_le_one h2pq).2 h1` duplicates `xBj_le_one` (Bounds.lean:46, which uses only `p_dot_q_pos` and `q2_le_two_p_dot_q`), and line 202 `(div_le_one hpk).symm` subsumes `yInel_le_one` (Bounds.lean:57, which uses only `p_dot_k_pos` and `p_dot_q_le_p_dot_k`). The general statement is proved here while the over-assuming special case stays in the repo as the public API.

summary: The domain and its interior/frontier results sit at the right level, and the symmetry- and positivity-free `invariants_mem_kinematicDomain_iff'` is correctly the general result from which the other two are derived. The one generality defect is that the PR reproves `0 < xBj`, `xBj ≤ 1` and `yInel ≤ 1` inline under minimal hypotheses while `Kinematics/Bounds.lean` keeps the same facts under the full `BasicAssumptions` bundle.
